verifications.note:
Re-verified by its originating reviewer (code-security-reviewer, session 2c88c5f6) on candidate sha256:55a411ae9f4e87473478988f3d9909752a934a547ba40acc1479f2b2bc3a24ce (source 660f40c), adversarially, at three levels.

1. The fix (T-DG5-BE-RG3, D-191; git diff 2fe8f85..660f40c). A shared rule, packages/reporting/src/xml-chars.ts, replaces every character XML 1.0 cannot carry with U+FFFD: C0 controls other than TAB/LF/CR, lone surrogates, U+FFFE and U+FFFF. The DOCX writer passes every run text and the core properties through it (docx.ts scriptRuns and the Document creator/title/description). The PPTX writer passes every string through it (pptx.ts author/company/title/subject, the illustrative label, the product name, slide titles, text items, table cells, the issue line and the footer). XLSX (xlsx/sheet.ts xmlText) shares the same rule. All three renderers then scan the finished package (assertWellFormedChars: raw characters and numeric character references); a hit is a RenderError, so the job fails with export.render_failed and no file is stored. I traced every text sink of docx.ts and pptx.ts: none bypasses xmlSafe. I also checked the reference regex digit by digit against the XML 1.0 Char production.

2. End to end, re-running my round-1 reproduction extended (46-ooxml-control-char-e2e.log). Setup: the real API and the real worker export runner on a migrated, demo-seeded disposable PostgreSQL. The transformation is renamed to 'International Roaming\u000Bprogramme\u0001(pasted)\u001F' (200, stored unchanged) and a RAID risk is recorded with U+000C and U+0008 (201). Charter DOCX, roadmap PPTX and XLSX, and RAID register XLSX are each exported in en and ar.
- Every job succeeded and the downloaded bytes equal fileSizeBytes.
- An independent scanner (raw characters and parsed numeric references against the Char production) finds no forbidden character in any XML or .rels part. The candidate's own strict checker (malformedParts) agrees.
- The name prints as 'International Roaming\uFFFDprogramme\uFFFD(pasted)', and the stored name is still the original after the exports.
- Formats a definition does not offer return 422 export.format_not_offered; they are recorded as n/a, and each OOXML format is exported in both languages at least once.
- Attempt 1 of this probe (46-ooxml-control-char-e2e.attempt1-format-not-offered.log) failed on my own probe defect, before any export was checked: it asked for charter PPTX, which the charter does not offer.

3. Renderer level (46b-ooxml-control-chars-renderer.log). Every forbidden code point (U+0001-U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E-U+001F, U+FFFE, U+FFFF, a lone high and a lone low surrogate) is placed in the transformation name, the code, a register cell, the branding product name, and the report header and footer. That gives 24 renders (docx/pptx/xlsx x en/ar x 4 positions), from the built dist and from src: all well-formed, U+FFFD in place. Harmless text is intact: tab, Arabic, an astral emoji, U+FFFD itself, and '' typed literally, which is escaped to '&#11;' and does not trip the package check.

Mutants: each one is killed, and the clean control passes.
- Renderer (46c-ooxml-renderer-mutants.log).
  - M0, an unmutated copy: passes 24/24.
  - M1 restores docx.ts and pptx.ts from 2fe8f85: 16/24 fail, with raw U+0001.. in word/document.xml, docProps/core.xml, docProps/app.xml and ppt/slides/slide2.xml.
  - M2 drops xmlSafe from the DOCX runs only: the 8 DOCX renders throw RenderError ('the package part word/document.xml is not well-formed XML 1.0'). The backstop works.
  - M3 turns off both xmlSafe and the package check: 24/24 fail, XLSX included.
  - Attempt 1 (46c-...attempt1-no-rsync.log) built no mutant, because rsync is not installed. Its M0 control failed and flagged it. Attempt 2 copies with tar.
- End to end (46d-ooxml-e2e-mutants.log).
  - M1 (pre-fix writers): charter.docx and roadmap.pptx jobs report succeeded, but docProps/core.xml holds raw U+000B, U+0001 and U+001F. This is the round-1 defect, reproduced on demand.
  - M2 (DOCX runs without xmlSafe, check kept): both charter.docx jobs FAIL with export.render_failed, and the download answers 422. A corrupt file is never stored as succeeded.
  - Both files were restored afterwards: git status is clean.

The ADR-0046 amendment (D-191) matches the code. Stored record text and the input rule are unchanged, and that is acceptable: PDF and CSV carry the characters, and every OOXML output is well-formed. F-DG5-100 is closed and verified (CLOSED_VERIFIED).
